question: Should maintainers keep this PR as the direct WebChat Stop recovery path and require a rebase onto the current chat UI layout, or replace it with a new current-main branch?
rationale: The bug remains on current main and the PR has useful proof, but the head is now conflicting and the session-state invariant needs owner acceptance before merge.

options.title: Rebase And Keep This Fix
options.body: Ask for or perform a focused port to `ui/src/pages/chat/run-lifecycle.ts`, `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts`, and `ui/src/e2e/...` while preserving the Gateway lifecycle guard.

options.title: Adopt Into A New Branch
options.body: If the conflict is too costly for the contributor branch, a maintainer can recreate the same direct Stop recovery against current main using this PR as proof and design input.

options.title: Pause For Unified Session Recovery
options.body: If maintainers want the compaction/restartRecoveryRuns variant solved in the same change, pause this PR until that broader session recovery design is scoped.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Keep This Fix
recommendation.body: Ask for or perform a focused port to `ui/src/pages/chat/run-lifecycle.ts`, `ui/src/pages/chat/chat-send.test.ts`, and `ui/src/e2e/...` while preserving the Gateway lifecycle guard.

likelyOwner.reason: They already reviewed the stale-run race on this PR and have recent gateway-area history on the affected server-methods surface.
